subject: Packaging mock-ups: matte or gloss?
body: Hi Lin, the two mock-ups look great. Our buyers are split between the matte and the gloss finish for the gift boxes. Which one would you go with? The printer needs our choice by Friday noon.

subject: Friday off?

subject: Invoice INV-2207 due tomorrow

subject: 打样有问题，重做还是退款？
